html:
Experience a relaxing and fun filled day exploring Nha Trang Bay with Vietlook Travel. This tour combines swimming at Mini Beach, a unique floating fishing village lunch, and a luxurious mineral mud bath and hydrotherapy experience at Hon Tam Island. Perfect for travelers seeking both adventure and relaxation.

TOUR ITINERARY

08:00 – 08:30
Car and professional English-speaking tour guide pick you up at the meeting point.
Board a speed canoe to begin the island tour.

MINI BEACH

09:00
Arrive at Mini Beach.

Free time to swim, relax, and enjoy the sea.

Optional water activities are available at your own expense, such as parasailing, jet ski, banana boat, and more.

FISHING VILLAGE

11:00
Visit the floating fishing village.

Enjoy lunch at a raft restaurant (lunch included in the tour).

The floating wooden raft restaurant has live tanks and nets filled with fish, lobster, crabs, and mussels (additional seafood may incur extra charges).

After lunch, free time to rest and relax.

HON TAM ISLAND

12:30
Transfer by canoe to Hon Tam Island.

Guests can enjoy the mineral mud bath package and full-body hydrotherapy massage.

Free use of towels and swimsuits (deposit required, refundable upon checkout).

Experience bathing under the mineral cascade and in the infinity/overflow pool, and enjoy the 2,400 m² mineral pool.

15:30 – 16:00
Return to the mainland by canoe. End of the tour.

TOUR PRICE

Price per person (pax): USD 32

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Hotel pick-up by car

  • Speed canoe transportation

  • Lunch at the island

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • Mud bath ticket

  • Bottled water

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • VAT

  • Personal expenses

  • Optional activities outside the program

CHILDREN POLICY

  • Children under 1 meter: Free of charge

  • From 1m to 1.29m: 70% of adult price

  • From 1.29m and above: Adult price applies
outline: Day 1: MINI BEACH - FISHING VILLAGE - HON TAM ISLAND
